reason: Issue 224 has not frozen the 200 development source-state groups with genuinely independent human labels. Those labels cannot be manufactured by an agent. Easy anchors and pre-outcome screen gates must also be frozen with that corpus before candidate outcomes.

ready_implementation.prepare_command: python tools/judge_reference.py prepare-screen --shared-root PROJECT_ROOT --bundle-set PINNED_RAW_FAMILY_BUNDLES.json --corpus ISSUE_224_FROZEN_DEVELOPMENT.json --out screen-jobs.json
ready_implementation.capture_seam: capture(profile, compiled_request, unique_output_dir, check_safety, model_identity): token-only, fresh serial reference; every branch in a separately authorised bounded machine window
ready_implementation.evaluate_command: python tools/judge_reference.py screen --shared-root PROJECT_ROOT --bundle-set PINNED_RAW_FAMILY_BUNDLES.json --corpus ISSUE_224_FROZEN_DEVELOPMENT.json --jobs screen-jobs.json --receipts REFERENCE_RECEIPT_DIRECTORY --out development-screen.json
ready_implementation.shared_authority: All semantic prompt compilation and option-logit combination use issue 223's normalize_request, compile_request and score_call. Engine capture remains token-only; no duplicate serving/evaluation readout method.
ready_implementation.denominator_policy: All 200 independent groups and every item, declared option, yes/no pair and easy anchor are required. No inner join or partial family result.
ready_implementation.failure_policy: If neither family passes the corpus's predeclared gates, stop_program=true, family_selection=null, disposition=reject and exit status 1. No calibration or temperature repair is attempted.

evidence_boundary: CPU test fixtures and source-authored arithmetic/read-position/coverage probes are not issue-224 gold, not the 200-group semantic screen, and not grounds for a family selection.
